title: Resin Bundle Pins
description: Backports resin pins for bundles to 1.21.1, compatible with Vanilla Backport
body:
# Resin Bundle Pins
A simple add-on to [Bundle Pins](https://modrinth.com/mod/bundle-pins) that adds support for resin pins to 1.21.1 with resin from [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport).

---
The following extra files are also available:
- _assets_ : **resourcepack** for the client to display the pin
- _data_ : **datapack** for the server to register & craft the pin
- _merged_ : **resourcepack & datapack** (_assets_ & _data_) unified in one file, can be used interchangeably by client & server, but still needs to be on both!
